//: Per-proc build manifest (B.1). The gate scripts are proc-agnostic: given a PROC name, they look it up here for the csproj to build, the assembly to run, and the service source the mutation check mutates. Adding a converted proc means adding an entry here and its files under generated/ — no gate edit. Keys are the fully-qualified proc name (schema.Proc), matching corpus/cases/<key>.json and corpus/golden/<key>__*.json.
